PLAN "12-Week Moderate-Intensity General Fitness (Post-MI Safe) + Cardiac Health Nutrition (Strength Emphasis with Safe Compounds, 5K Walk Test Build)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS

NUTRITION
  ENERGY:
    target "moderate deficit (-300..400 kcal/day) unless underweight or symptomatic"

    protein "1.2..1.4 g/kg/day across 3..4 meals"
    fat "25..35% kcal, emphasize unsaturated"
    carbs "remainder from high-fiber, low-glycemic sources"
    fiber "30..38 g/day from foods"
    sodium "<1500..2000 mg/day per cardiology guidance"

    hydration "2..3 L/day water; avoid sugar-sweetened beverages; limit alcohol"

    - "nuts_seeds (unsalted) ~1 oz/day"
    - "fish (fatty fish 2x/week)"
    - "low-fat dairy or fortified alternatives"
    - "oils: olive oil, canola oil; herbs_spices instead of salt"
  LIMIT_FOODS:

    - "refined grains; pastries"
    - "added sugars; sugar-sweetened drinks"
    - "trans_fats; limit saturated_fats"
    - "excess alcohol (max 1 drink/day if any, with MD approval)"

    test_guidelines "5K is a brisk WALK only; stop or slow if HR exceeds cap or symptoms occur; record time, average HR, and RPE."
